# Alert classifier (pilot)

**Pilot.** Nothing in production depends on this classifier; it exists to learn whether alert text can be sorted into six classes better than by rules. Generated by `make alert-classifier` from the hand labels in `evals/alert_labels.csv`; do not edit.

- Rows: 50 distinct subway alerts, labelled by hand (guide: `evals/ALERT_LABELLING.md`).
- Classes: shuttle_diversion (5), delay (12), station_or_stop_closure (5), accessibility (22), schedule_change (0), other (6).
- Protocol: stratified 5-fold cross-validation, seed 7, the same folds for every model; scores are from the out-of-fold predictions. The LLM is zero-shot, so it sees no training folds. Classes with fewer than 5 examples cannot be stratified across all folds; per-class numbers on small classes are noisy.
- Small sample: differences of a few points are not evidence of a better model.

## Summary

| Model | Precision (macro) | Recall (macro) | F1 (macro) | Accuracy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rule baseline (GTFS effect + keywords) | 81% | 71% | 73% | 92% |
| TF-IDF + logistic regression | 68% | 61% | 63% | 84% |
| LLM zero-shot | not run | not run | not run | not run |

LLM zero-shot: not run: no OPENAI_API_KEY (no key, no calls).

## Five hardest examples

Most models wrong first, then the lowest logistic-regression probability for the hand label.

- Alert 1046615 (effect OTHER_EFFECT), hand label `other`: "The west bike cage at Alewife will be closed due to maintenance beginning Monday, December 14. Bikers may use the east bike cage." Wrong in: Rule baseline (GTFS effect + keywords), TF-IDF + logistic regression.
- Alert 1045514 (effect REDUCED_SERVICE), hand label `shuttle_diversion`: "Green Line: Dec 4–7, no trains between North Station & Babcock St (B), St. Mary's St (C), Brookline Hills (D) & Heath St (E). Use buses between Babcock St, St. Mary's, Brookline Hills, Heath St & Back Bay. Use Orange Line between Back Bay & North Station." Wrong in: Rule baseline (GTFS effect + keywords), TF-IDF + logistic regression.
- Alert 1001861 (effect UNKNOWN_EFFECT), hand label `station_or_stop_closure`: "The stairway connecting the Jackson Square lobby and the south end of the platform is closed until winter 2026. Use the stairway at the north end of the platform. This closure is for the construction of a new stairway and a second elevator." Wrong in: TF-IDF + logistic regression.
- Alert 1032947 (effect UNKNOWN_EFFECT), hand label `other`: "Due to construction, the staircase at the north end of the Savin Hill platform is out of service. Riders should follow station personnel and signage to the alternate staircase located in the center of the platform." Wrong in: TF-IDF + logistic regression.
- Alert 1042451 (effect OTHER_EFFECT), hand label `other`: "Quincy Adams Garage Notice: Beginning Tuesday, November 3, MBTA parking at Quincy Adams will be limited to the A side of the Garage. The B side of the garage will be reserved for Logan Express Braintree." Wrong in: TF-IDF + logistic regression.
